offers_products.reason: Asset-light manager; managed REITs and clients own the properties, RMR earns management fees.

offers_services.reason: Property management, asset management and advisory services to managed REITs, funds and investors.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are REITs, institutional investors, joint venture partners and private funds, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Managed REITs, institutional investors and separate-account clients are the buyers of management services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing multi-year management contracts with REITs and funds generate recurring base management and property fees.

cyclical_demand.reason: Management contracts with REITs continue through downturns; fees are largely tied to ongoing asset management.

big_ticket.reason: Fee-based management services billed continuously, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for staff expertise in property management, leasing, engineering and asset management.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are public REITs and institutional investors.

asset_heavy.reason: Fee-earning manager; the managed REITs own the properties, though RMR does co-invest in some ventures.
